text:
Maya Patel: Quick design review — the 'burst quanta' control is still confusing in the Autoscale modal. Users keep asking if it's additional GPUs or a percentage increase. :eyes:
Alex (Design): Agreed. I think the label should be 'Burst capacity (GPUs)' and we show a small helper: 'Adds X GPUs for short bursts (min: 1 step)'.
Tom Rivera: +1 on explicit unit. Also worried about how this interacts with min/max sliders; people might think burst bypasses SLOs.
Liam Chen: From infra: burst is a separate quota, but we can make the tooltip show fallback behavior. Could show: 'If pool saturated, requests route to fallback model'.
Alex (Design): Mockup suggestion: move burst under the pool picker, visually group with capacity knobs. Add an info icon with this copy: "Burst capacity temporarily adds queued instances up to the selected amount. Does not change Min/Max settings; fallback policies still apply."
Jules (a11y): A11y notes: if we rename to 'Burst capacity (GPUs)' ensure aria-label includes the parent pool name, e.g., aria-label="Burst capacity for Pool: default-gpu-pool". Also keyboard focus order should be Min -> Max -> Burst -> SLO slider.
Tom Rivera: UX question: should burst increments be the same step as Min/Max (1 GPU) or a larger quantum? Product leaning: let users choose quanta presets (1, 2, 4) with microcopy: 'Choose burst granularity'.
Maya Patel: Good idea. Add a small selector labeled 'Burst granularity' with compact radio buttons: 1 | 2 | 4 GPUs. Default 1.
Liam Chen: Implementation note: if granularity > 1, tooltip should clarify billing implications. Example line: 'Billing rounds up to granularity for bursts.'
Alex (Design): Copy tweak proposal for SLO slider: change 'Acceptable latency' -> 'Target tail latency (ms)'. People read 'acceptable' as permissive.
Jules (a11y): Contrast check: SLO slider track color fails contrast at 12px labels. Use 3:1 for small text or bump font size. Also ensure the slider value live region updates for screen readers.
Tom Rivera: Can we add a guardrail inline validation: if Min + Burst > pool capacity show warning 'May exceed pool capacity — consider increasing pool or lowering burst'. Should be non-blocking.
Maya Patel: Yes, non-blocking warning with suggested actions (button links): 'Open pool settings' and 'Preview cost impact'.
Liam Chen: For pool picker: defaulting users to 'auto-select' pool caused confusion. Let's show explicit default and a link 'Why this pool?' that opens a sidenav with routing rationale.
Alex (Design): Tiny microcopy changes: replace 'Burst' label tooltip 'Short-lived scale' -> 'Short-lived scale (seconds to minutes)' and add example: 'e.g., web traffic spike for ~5m'.
Jules (a11y): Also voiceover tip: announce when preview cost updates after changing burst granularity: "Cost preview updated: estimated hourly cost $X".
Tom Rivera: QA note: add an e2e test that tabs through controls and asserts focus order and aria attributes.
Maya Patel: I'll update the figma and post new frames. Can someone sanity-check the helper copy before I hand off to eng? :thumbsup:
Alex (Design): I'll do a copy pass and post comments on the frame by EOD.
Liam Chen: I'll review the API surface for burst granularity; might need a small param change.
Jules (a11y): Happy to review a11y updates once the new copy is up.
InfraBot: Deployment scheduled: no impact.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — landing action items: Alex copy pass, Liam API check, Jules a11y review. Will update thread with figma link.
